title: The Big Tasty Exotic 100ml Shortfill 0mg (70VG/30PG)
description:
Ready for something that’s much more exotic to vape with? Then try The Big Tasty’s 100ml Exotic Shortfill E-liquids which brings some authentic exotic tasting fruits to vaping in full force. Pick from five exquisite flavours that each brilliantly blend fruits that will truly make any mouth water upon experience the sheer exoticness of these flavours.
Coming with a higher VG ratio, with any of the Big Tasty 100ml Juiced shortfills are perfect for any Sub-Ohm vaping devices such as pods and kit. Once experience, you’ll receive the full force of your chosen flavour with great vapour cloud production that avoids giving you hits to the throat as you puff away. To add some nicotine into the proceedings, there is room for two nicotine shots to get your fix.
– Made in the UK
– 0mg Nicotine Strength
– 100ml E-Liquid Content in a 120ml Shortfill Bottle
– Space for 2 x 10ml (18mg) Nicotine shots
– 70VG/30PG
– Ideal for Sub-Ohm Devices and Kits
– Childproof Cap and Tamper Evident Seal
– Recyclable Bottle
– TPD Complaint
Flavours:
Aquamelon Pome
Ripe watermelon and preppy pomegranate are brought together to make for a truly tasty, fruit filled blend to quench your thirst during summer.
Dragon Fruit Twist
Dragon fruits with raspberries and blackcurrant notes that conjures up a truly sweet blended mist as both refreshing and potent.
Guava Lemonade
Authentic Italian lemons and tropical guava combined into something super refreshing to taste like a perfectly distilled, pure lemonade.
La Rosa Tropicana
Pink raspberries and blackcurrants brought together into something truly sweet, fragrant and classic to your taste buds.
Midnight Berry Colada
Purple dark blackberries, coconut and strawberries all blended into a truly irresistible taste that will heighten your senses and enrapture your taste buds.
